pending: This section is not ready yet.
gate: Personal records are unavailable at this stage. You can return to the game instructions.
resumeInfo: Your round is still here. Resume when you’re ready; nothing has been marked complete.
unknown: The previous round could not be verified. It cannot be resumed. You can start a new round or leave.
unreported: Resume when you’re ready, or tell us how it went.
preReport: Played with the phone set aside? You can tell us how it went here.
optional: Want to record how it went? This is optional.
reportedEarly: Stopped early — thanks for letting us know.
resumed: You’re back in the same round.
soundPending: Sound is pending. Press again to cancel.
criticalMissing: Required mission illustrations could not load. You can start when the mission is ready.
discardBody: This play report is not saved to a player yet. Continuing will discard this report, but keep any history you already saved.
accessText: You can read the instructions and all the steps, enlarge the page, or ask a grown-up for help. Sound is optional.
askText: You can ask a grown-up to look through the instructions with you.
storageUnavailable: Round information cannot be retained in this tab. Reopening the page may prevent you from resuming the same round.
localDisclosure: Player history is stored only in this browser on this device. It is not an online account. Clearing browser data may remove it.
localRetention: This information may remain here until you delete it or your browser or operating system removes it. It is not sent to or retained on a server.
nicknameHelp: Use a nickname instead of your real full name. Leave this blank for a label such as Player 1 or Player 2.
nameError: Use up to 64 characters, without control characters.
createInfo: You do not need a player to play. Creating a player does not save the report.
chooseInfo: Choose a player, then press Save separately. Selecting a player does not verify identity.
noPlayers: There are no players in this browser yet. You can return to play without saving.
localUnavailable: Local records are unavailable right now. No save has been verified; you can keep playing.
localChanged: Local information changed. Check your selection again.
savePending: Saving on this device… You can keep playing.
saveVerified: Saved to this player on this device, based on your report. Catches and skill are not measured.
saveUnverified: The record could not be verified. You can check the same operation or return to play.
noReport: There is no new report to save.
reportChangeBody: This player's existing local report will change; no new round or second record will be created. New status:
reportCorrected: The saved report was corrected and the history summary updated.
correctionRequired: This report was already saved to this player. No second record was made. To correct it, open its record status in the player's history.
correctionInfo: You are moving this existing record to another player. It leaves the previous player’s history; it does not create another play result.
nameInfo: Changing a nickname does not add a play result.
nameSaved: The nickname was updated in this browser.
historySummary: {completed} completion reports across {distinct} different missions · {early} early-stop reports
historyHonesty: Only reports explicitly saved to this player are counted; physical catches and skill are not measured.
certificateScope: The certificate uses only this player's saved reports in this browser. Legacy records do not count; physical skill is not measured.
certificateUnavailable: The certificate condition is no longer met or local records could not be read. Check the history again.
deletePlayerBody: This player’s label, nickname, linked local reports and pending operations will be deleted. Other players and legacy data remain. This cannot be undone.
deleteAll: Delete all local player and history data
deleteAllBody: All JUMVI players, nicknames, personal reports, pending operations and legacy player/team/history data in this browser will be deleted. Play and sound preferences remain. Previously downloaded backups are not deleted. This cannot be undone.
deleted: The selected local data was deleted.
partialDelete: New player and history data was deleted; deletion of legacy data could not be verified. You can retry deleting all local data.
legacyNotice: Legacy local player/history data is present. It is not imported as new personal records or verified success. Delete all local data includes it.
adultPurpose: Mission book, product care and support. Players and progress are optional.
guestInfo: The new game is not attributed to a player. No player is required; sound starts off.
previousInfo: The previous round and unsaved report are kept separately in this open page. Closing the page may lose the report.
guestStart: Continue to a new unassigned game
groupInfo: No player needs a profile. Shared play is not automatically added to individual histories.
returnInfo: Ready for another round? Choose how you’d like to play. No player is selected automatically.
managementEmpty: You can play without creating a player. Add one only if you want to keep progress on this device.
certificateIntro: Save “I finished it” for 36 different missions to the same player on this device to earn a play certificate. It records your reports, not measured skill. Saving progress is optional.
